ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 20:1 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-grey) to high-intensity (white) pixels. High-intensity pixels are localized at distal tips and scattered as punctate spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity black region across both lobes. High-intensity geometric clusters located at both lateral tips. Randomly distributed high-intensity punctate blobs across the central fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 135 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing edge with non-uniform serration. Right lobe displays higher frequency peaks; left lobe presents smoother segments with occasional sharp micro-indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating at the median notch and sweeping upwards toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-intensity pixels at both distal fluke tips (barnacle colonies). Sparsely distributed individual circular white spots across the ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct light-colored linear feature on the mid-left lobe, oriented diagonally. Secondary shorter linear features detected near the central notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation at distal lateral tips; multiple linear scrape marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, high-contrast circular ring-shaped mark located on the outer third of the right lobe.
